title: Production Recovery authority foundation and operational adapters

phases.objective: Provide deployment-owned Production Recovery approval and execution-ticket authority primitives over the existing independent Recovery Control Store without creating a complete live graph or touching Production.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Server-owned foundation authorities resolve without exposing a live Production graph.
steps: Create ticket and confirmation authorities.
Bind the durable Recovery Control Store and exact verifier identity.
Wrap server-derived Production deployment attestation.
Keep consequential adapters deferred.
assertions: No provider/database/deployment mutation occurs.
production_live_enabled=false.
activation_eligible=false.
secrets_included=false

phases.objective: Compose every canonical Recovery adapter through deployment-owned authority wrappers while remaining injected_non_live and executing no Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A complete server-managed Recovery adapter graph resolves in injected_non_live mode with caller routing overrides denied and no consequential authority invoked during construction.
steps: Reuse the merged Production authority foundation.
Wrap deployment-owned mutation execution with an allowlisted Recovery execution payload.
Wrap independent role-aware readback with mutation_authority=false.
Wrap immutable partial receipts, durable inspection proof, and the Governance Migration Ledger.
Validate the complete graph through the canonical server-managed authority binding.
Construct Production Recovery composition in injected_non_live mode only.
assertions: All canonical Recovery composition components are configured.
Caller-selected repository/workflow/ref/host/path/SSH/credential/token routing is rejected.
Recovery Store verifier identity remains exact.
Readback authority is independent, role-aware, and non-mutating.
Partial receipts require persisted=true and durable=true and forbid automatic rerun.
Durable proof must be server-derived with explicit selected roles.
Governance Migration Ledger finalization requires durable=true.
No adapter invocation occurs during composition construction.
live_activation=false, production_live_enabled=false, activation_eligible=false.
secrets_included=false.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Server-owned readers re-evaluate the complete non-live graph, signed Staging certification, exact Production identity/parity, Control Store provisioning evidence, and independent readback certification without granting Production activation.
steps: Read the complete operational composition through a deployment-owned reader and require injected_non_live with all components configured.
Read and re-evaluate the fresh signed Staging Recovery certification instead of trusting a persisted boolean verdict.
Bind the certification to server-managed expected Production identity through exact deployment attestation and artifact parity.
Require separately governed Recovery Control Store provisioning/readback evidence rather than treating disposable durability certification as Production provisioning.
Require live non-Production independent role-aware same-fence readback certification for the same implementation SHA.
Return a bounded canary readiness decision while keeping activation_eligible=false and production_live_enabled=false.
assertions: No caller-provided evidence can be supplied to the readiness authority.
A production_live composition is rejected by the canary readiness gate.
Stale, wrong-SHA, cross-target, unsigned, or parity-mismatched evidence fails closed.
Disposable Recovery Control Store resilience evidence does not substitute for Production provisioning/readback evidence.
Independent readback certification must be live_non_production, role-aware, same-fence, and mutation_authority=false.
Reader failures expose bounded error codes only and cannot leak secret-bearing error messages.
canary_ready never implies activation_eligible or production_live_enabled.
No provider/database/deployment mutation occurs during readiness evaluation.

phases.objective: Execute fresh live non-Production certification of the complete deployment-owned Recovery implementation and bind it to exact Production deployment/provisioning evidence without enabling Production mutation.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Post-merge exact-main Recovery canary certification sequence
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Fresh signed Staging Recovery evidence, independent readback certification, exact Production deployment identity/parity, and governed Control Store provisioning evidence converge into canary_ready=true while Production activation remains disabled.
steps: Deploy the exact merged main implementation to the governed non-Production certification target.
Produce and countersign a fresh Staging Recovery Phase B certificate for the exact implementation SHA.
Certify independent role-aware same-fence readback on the live non-Production target.
Collect separately authorized Production Recovery Control Store provisioning/readback evidence without activating Recovery.
Read exact server-managed Production deployment identity and prove artifact parity.
Evaluate Production Recovery canary readiness and require canary_ready=true with activation_eligible=false.

phases.objective: Keep Production live Recovery blocked until fresh certification, exact deployment attestation, complete activation readiness, and separate explicit activation authorization exist.
